title: Union-Find Connectivity
summary: Maintain connected components under edge additions so repeated same-component queries can be answered through component representatives.
recognition_signals: queries repeatedly ask whether two items are in the same component
the exact path between connected items is not required
core_rules: Each set has one representative returned by find.
Union combines two representatives, and path compression or rank/size keeps representative lookup efficient.
Union-find does not retain enough information to reconstruct an exact route.
structural_steps: initialize every item as its own set
union different representatives when an edge is added

common_confusions.distinction: Traversal can recover paths and inspect graph structure. Union-find is specialized for component membership under merges and deliberately discards route information.
